answer: Continuous physical-presence beaconing. Each agent must periodically solve a challenge tied to a locally sensed value (e.g., ambient light spectrum, including violet bands) that is stable across the operator's single location but unpredictable remotely. The agent reports readings on a randomized spiral schedule converging toward a nadir offset known only to the verifier. Faking requires deploying a distinct, calibrated sensor per identity at a separate physical site; sharing one site yields correlated readings the verifier flags.
